title: Synthesis, characterization, and anticancer potential of novel NHC ligands and their selenium complexes: a combined in vitro and in silico investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,409-424
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08393A, Paper

Boutheina Boualia, Abd el-Krim Sandeli, Enes Evren, İsmail Özdemir, Hüseyin Karci, Muhammed Dündar, İlknur Özdemir, Nevin Gürbüz, Ahmet Koç, Houssem Boulebd
The newly synthesized NHC ligands showed potent cytotoxicity toward HCT116 and SH-SY5Y, while their Se complexes were non-toxic within the tested range. Docking studies revealed high affinity for PARP-1 and tubulin.
